## Self-Healing Technical Documentation v1.0.0

Rules-first stale documentation detection for Python repositories.

Highlights:

- No OpenAI API key required.
- Markdown and Python parsing with stable code-to-doc links.
- Optional local Ollama review and validated repairs.
- GitHub Action summaries and pull request integration.

See [README.md](https://github.com/rajaryan-14/self_healing_technical_documentation#readme) for setup and usage.
